description: Test whether population-tolerated TANC2 pLoF alleles are positionally segregated from pathogenic truncating variants
code:
import requests, json, time, re
import pandas as pd, numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy import stats

# ---- gnomAD v4 HC pLoF in TANC2 with genomic positions ----
q = """
query { gene(gene_symbol: "TANC2", reference_genome: GRCh38) {
  start stop
  variants(dataset: gnomad_r4) { variant_id pos consequence
    transcript_consequence { lof major_consequence }
    exome { ac an } genome { ac an } } } }
"""
d = requests.post("https://gnomad.broadinstitute.org/api", json={"query": q}, timeout=300).json()["data"]["gene"]
G0,G1 = d["start"], d["stop"]
rows=[]
for v in d["variants"]:
    tc=v.get("transcript_consequence") or {}
    ex=v.get("exome") or {}; ge=v.get("genome") or {}
    rows.append({"pos":v["pos"],"lof":tc.get("lof"),"csq":tc.get("major_consequence"),
                 "ac":(ex.get("ac") or 0)+(ge.get("ac") or 0)})
V=pd.DataFrame(rows)
hc=V[V.lof=="HC"].copy()
hc["rel"]=(hc.pos-G0)/(G1-G0)   # TANC2 is on the + strand, so rel ~ 5'->3'

# ---- ClinVar P/LP truncating genomic positions ----
eutils="https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/"
def get(u,p,t=6):
    for _ in range(t):
        r=requests.get(u,params=p,timeout=120)
        try: return r.json()
        except Exception: time.sleep(3)
    raise RuntimeError
s=get(eutils+"esearch.fcgi",{"db":"clinvar","term":'TANC2[gene]',"retmax":1000,"retmode":"json"})
ids=s["esearchresult"]["idlist"]; cv=[]
for i in range(0,len(ids),200):
    es=get(eutils+"esummary.fcgi",{"db":"clinvar","id":",".join(ids[i:i+200]),"retmode":"json"})
    res=es.get("result",{})
    for uid in res.get("uids",[]):
        x=res[uid]; g=x.get("germline_classification",{})
        vs=x.get("variation_set",[{}])[0]
        loc=[l for l in vs.get("variation_loc",[]) if l.get("assembly_name")=="GRCh38"]
        p=int(loc[0]["start"]) if loc and loc[0].get("start") else None
        cv.append({"title":x.get("title",""),"clinsig":g.get("description",""),"pos":p})
    time.sleep(1.0)
C=pd.DataFrame(cv)
plp_tr=C[C.clinsig.isin(["Pathogenic","Likely pathogenic","Pathogenic/Likely pathogenic"]) &
         C.title.str.contains(r"fs\)|Ter\)|[+-]1G>|[+-]2[ACGT]>",regex=True,na=False) &
         ~C.title.str.contains("GRCh",na=False)].dropna(subset=["pos"]).copy()
plp_tr["rel"]=(plp_tr.pos-G0)/(G1-G0)

obs_hc = hc[hc.ac>=2]            # recurrent population pLoF, i.e. tolerated
print("gnomAD HC pLoF: n=%d (AC>=2: n=%d)"%(len(hc),len(obs_hc)))
print("ClinVar P/LP truncating with GRCh38 position: n=%d"%len(plp_tr))

# Hypothesis: tolerated population pLoF alleles sit 3' of disease-causing truncating variants
u=stats.mannwhitneyu(obs_hc.rel, plp_tr.rel, alternative="greater")
print("\nMann-Whitney U (population AC>=2 pLoF rel. position > ClinVar P/LP truncating): U=%.0f p=%.2e"%(u.statistic,u.pvalue))
print("  median relative position: population AC>=2 pLoF = %.3f ; ClinVar P/LP truncating = %.3f"%(obs_hc.rel.median(),plp_tr.rel.median()))
# weight by allele count
w = np.repeat(obs_hc.rel.values, obs_hc.ac.values.astype(int))
print("  allele-weighted median population pLoF position = %.3f (n alleles=%d)"%(np.median(w),len(w)))
print("  fraction of population pLoF ALLELES in last 10%% of the gene: %.1f%%"%(100*(w>0.90).mean()))
print("  fraction of ClinVar P/LP truncating in last 10%% of the gene: %.1f%%"%(100*(plp_tr.rel>0.90).mean()))

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(12,5))
ax.scatter(plp_tr.rel, np.full(len(plp_tr),1.0), s=45, color="#C44E52", label="ClinVar pathogenic/likely pathogenic truncating (n=%d)"%len(plp_tr), zorder=3)
ax.scatter(obs_hc.rel, np.full(len(obs_hc),0.6), s=np.clip(obs_hc.ac*4,20,400), color="#4C72B0", alpha=.6,
           label="gnomAD v4 pLoF seen in >1 allele (size = allele count, n=%d)"%len(obs_hc), zorder=3)
ax.axvspan(0.90,1.0,color="0.85",zorder=0)
ax.text(0.945,1.25,"3' 10%\n(NMD escape)",ha="center",fontsize=9,color="0.35")
ax.set_ylim(0.3,1.4); ax.set_yticks([]); ax.set_xlim(-0.02,1.02)
ax.set_xlabel("Relative position along the TANC2 locus, chr17:62,966,235-63,427,703 (GRCh38), 5' to 3'")
ax.legend(loc="lower left",fontsize=9)
ax.set_title("Population-tolerated TANC2 loss-of-function alleles sit at the 3' end; disease-causing truncating\nvariants do not (Mann-Whitney p = %.1e)"%u.pvalue, fontsize=12)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
